title: How Does Firm Scope Depend on Customer Switching Costs? Evidence from Mobile Telecommunications Markets
eligible_reason: Table 10 column 1 is a static TWFE regression of the within-operator switching rate on a binary mobile-number-portability (MNP) indicator that switches on at country-specific quarters, with operator fixed effects and year-quarter fixed effects, no controls (Code-Proposition 1.do line 165). MNP was introduced in different countries in different quarters, so there are many adoption cohorts; never-treated countries are dropped (line 137), so comparisons use not-yet-treated and always-treated operators. The headline Tables 6, 7 and A3 interact mnp with the time-invariant multiproduct indicator (mnp##multi) and are excluded as subgroup-by-treatment interactions. Data are proprietary (GSMA Intelligence) and are not in the package.
design_notes: Operator-by-quarter panel from GSMA Intelligence (variables per Sample.xlsx: time, year, quarter, id_operator, Launchdate, id_country, connections, prepaidpct, marketshare, arpu, penetration, HHI, population, GDP, pop_density, mnp, churn, churn_prepaid, churn_contract). mnp is described in Sample.xlsx as 'Binary measure equal to 1 for observations in the quarters after the policy was introduced in the focal country and 0 for prior observations' (absorbing, country level). The do-files assume the data are already xtset by id_operator and time (they use F4.mnp / L4.mnp lags without declaring tsset). Proposition 1 code: drops operators with missing prepaid share and never-treated countries, defines multi = 1 - pure (pure = >99% prepaid or <1% prepaid before MNP), runs Table 10 (switch_rate on mnp, multiproduct firms only), Table A3 (full sample log_connections on mnp##multi plus HHI GDP population penetration), then restricts to a hand-listed caliper-matched sample of 54 operators (lines 226-332) for Tables 1-7 and Figures 1-2. Table 6/7 regressions are xtreg fe with mnp##multi, with and without controls, robust or cluster(id_country), plus random-effects columns. Proposition 2 code: entry-strategy cross-sectional regressions (Table 9: reg/probit/logit Multi_entry on late_entry) and an unreported xtreg Nco mnp i.year, fe (line 146).
main_or_robustness: secondary (Table 10 is a mechanism table on switching rates; the headline Tables 6-7 use mnp x multiproduct interactions)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Not determinable from the package: the full panel is not shipped and Sample.xlsx shows only one Thai operator (mnp = 0 throughout). MNP implementation dates are country specific (xconnect.net / Wikipedia lists cross-checked by the authors), spanning roughly 1997-2015, so the number of adoption quarters is large. Never-treated countries are dropped (line 137); countries that adopted MNP before the panel start (around 2003q3 in Sample.xlsx) would be always treated.

specs.outcome: switch_rate (= churn_contract*postpaidpct + churn_prepaid*prepaidpct - churn, floored at 0; constructed line 156)
specs.treatment_definition: 1 in quarters after mobile number portability was introduced in the operator's country, 0 before (country-level, absorbing)
specs.cluster: robust (xtreg fe robust = clustered by id_operator; column labelled 'Firm Cluster')
specs.sample_condition: pure==0 (multiproduct operators) & sample2 (observations with non-missing HHI GDP population penetration, from line 160); never-treated countries and operators with missing prepaid share dropped (lines 136-137)
specs.data_file: GSMA Intelligence operator-quarter panel (not shipped; structure in Sample.xlsx)
specs.notes: Column 2 is a random-effects version; columns 3-5 add HHI GDP population penetration (time-varying controls).

specs.exclusion_reason: subgroup-by-treatment interaction: mnp##multi (multi is a time-invariant multiproduct indicator); the DiD coefficient of interest is mnp#multi, not a binary treatment effect
specs.treatment_definition: mnp (country MNP indicator) interacted with multi = 1 - pure
specs.controls: none in col 1; HHI GDP population penetration in cols 2-5
specs.sample_condition: hand-listed caliper-matched sample of 54 operators (lines 226-332) & sample (non-missing controls)
specs.reported_location: Table 6 (log subscribers); Table 7 (logrev) at line 592; Table A3 full sample at line 198
specs.notes: Code line numbers for Table 6/7 refer to the file as shipped (repetitive lead/lag construction lines precede them).

specs.exclusion_reason: apparently unreported (no outreg2); outcome Nco is a country-year count regressed on operator-level panel with operator FE and year FE after dropping incumbents and pre-2000 entrants; the sample excludes never-treated countries
specs.outcome: Nco (number of non-incumbent operators in country-year)
specs.sample_condition: LY>=2000 & not incumbent & never-treated countries dropped

data_files: Sample.xlsx (illustrative subsample: one operator, 9,246 rows, variable dictionary)
data_files_note: README: 'The dataset is proprietary and not publicly available' (GSMA Intelligence, www.gsmaintelligence.com); authors 'willing to fully cooperate with investigators'. MNP dates come from public sources. Replication requires a GSMA Intelligence licence or author cooperation.
priority_note: Eligible design (Table 10 col 1) but data proprietary and absent; feasible only via GSMA licence or authors.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Table/column mapping inferred from do-file comments and outreg2 calls; verify against the published article. Eligible spec is a secondary mechanism result, not the headline. Headline results (Tables 6-7) are mnp x multiproduct heterogeneity regressions on a 54-operator matched sample and are excluded under the subgroup-by-treatment rule.
